description: 500 benchmark combos for best_path analysis; each is run in planner and rule_based modes.

rationale.targets: Same band as configs/benchmark_runs.json: density 1.45-1.95, det_velocity 6500-9500 and det_pressure 17.5-40.5 rising linearly with density plus Gaussian noise (sd 150 m/s, 1 GPa, clipped), hf_solid uniform -130..+100.
rationale.beam: depth in {3,4,5,6,8}, width in {3,4,5,6,8}, top_k in {2,3,4,5}, cycled with periods 1/5/25 so all 100 combinations co-occur. random_seed unique per combo.
